bagPolicy.summary: Each ticket holder may bring one clear bag up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches or a one-gallon freezer bag, plus one separate clutch up to 5.5 × 8.5 inches. Medically necessary bags are inspected and tagged.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The venue lists downtown Greenville public garages and privately operated event lots. Limited accessible parking in its VIP lot costs $5 and is first come first served.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Rideshare pickup and drop-off are at the on-site GSP International Airport Box Office near the First Citizens Bank entrance, at North Academy and East North Streets.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The arena sells food and drinks inside; its A–Z guide does not set a universal concession menu.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible parking is in the VIP lot between the Church Street garage and the arena, costs $5 and is limited. Contact venue staff for accessible seating and entry.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: No re-entry is allowed for any event.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The arena A–Z guide does not state a general concert will-call pickup method.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Guests with medical bags can have them checked and tagged by supervisors at each main entrance; event-specific opening times are posted with the show.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
